title: The Language of the reservoir
author: Jude Thornbury
blurb: Coral Okafor, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. Then the last speaker of a language asks for one final student — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must say goodbye properly, at last, out loud, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
